┊ 💬 Now I understand the issue. The deploy script needs to:
1. Run the healthcheck first
2. Only switch the symlink if the healthcheck passes
3. If healthcheck fails, keep the current symlink unchanged
The test expects:
- `deploy.sh releases/good` - should succeed and switch symlink to `releases/good`
- `deploy.sh releases/bad` - should fail (healthcheck exits 1) and NOT change the symlink (should still point to `releases/good`)
